draft.subject: Subject: Update: Replacement Vehicle Dispatched for Shakti Cement Shipment
draft.body:
Subject: Update: Replacement Vehicle Dispatched for Shakti Cement Shipment

Dear Shakti Cement Team,

Please be advised that vehicle HR16SP9238 experienced a mechanical breakdown and has been replaced by HR24VR5371.
The replacement vehicle has been dispatched from our Gurgaon hub and is currently en route to Kanpur.
The estimated arrival time is approximately 12.8 hours, which remains within our standard 36-hour door-to-door service window.
We will continue to monitor the shipment closely and provide further updates as needed.

Best regards,
Meridian Freight Dispatch
